messages.author: 9bc7596ef408aba5
messages.subject: Part 2 error: 'DAYL5HOUR' not found
parts:
Hi, 

I recently ran a batch of 40 raw csv files exported from Actilife with physical activity data. All but one file ran correctly, and gave me the following error code in part 2, "Error in g.getM5L5(varnum, ws3, t0_LFMF, t1_LFMF, params_247[["M5L5res"]],  : object 'DAYL5HOUR' not found". Any guidance on this error message would be much appreciated. I am using version 3.1-2 of GGIR. I have attached the  .RData file stored in the meta/basic subfolder. See my code below: 

library(remotes)
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR")
library(GGIR)

#  Current Working Directories --------------------------------------------
shell.input <- "R:/Sweeney_Research/TEAM ActiGraph Data/RAW CSV Zipped/Cohort 3/6 months/3027"
shell.output <-"R:/Sweeney_Research/TEAM ActiGraph Data/Post-Process/Cohort 3/6 months"

# Processing Shell Script -------------------------------------------------

# Set number of files in the directory
f1 = as.numeric(length(list.files(shell.input)));f1

g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2),
  datadir=shell.input,
  outputdir=shell.output,
  f0=1,
  f1=f1,
  overwrite=TRUE, 
  do.imp=FALSE, 
  idloc=2, 
  print.filename=TRUE,
  storefolderstructure=FALSE,
  #-------------------------------
  #Part 1 parameters
  #-------------------------------
  windowsizes = c(1,900,3600), 
  do.cal=TRUE, 
  do.enmo = TRUE, 
  chunksize=1,
  printsummary=TRUE,
  #-------------------------------
  # Part 2 parameters:
  #-------------------------------
  strategy = 1, 
  hrs.del.start = 0, 
  hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 30, 
  includedaycrit = 1, 
  winhr = 5, 
  qlevels = c(), 
  qwindow=c(5,24), 
  ilevels = (c(0,50,150,500,8000)), 
  iglevels = TRUE, 
  mvpathreshold =c(50,150,500), 
  closedbout=FALSE,
  timewindow = c("MM"), 
  do.report=c(2))

#####

Thanks for your help!

Allison

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 2 error: 'DAYL5HOUR' not found
parts:
Dear Allison,

Thanks for sharing the test file and R code. I tried to reproduce your error but for me the code runs fine.

Did you update GGIR to a recent version?

If that does not address the issue. Could it be that you were still using an old GGIR output folder with an old config.csv file?  If yes, maybe delete that config.csv file and try again?

Further, I made only minor changes:

f1 = as.numeric(length(list.files(shell.input)));f1
is not needed, you can just specify f1 = 0 which is the default and GGIR will figure out how many files there are.

g.shell.GGIR(
is no longer necessary, you can also write just GGIR(, without 'g.shell.'

Best,
Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 2 error: 'DAYL5HOUR' not found
parts:
Hello,

I saw a similar error earlier today which was the result of a user masking all the data and then expecting GGIR to still run meaningful analysis. In the case earlier today the solution was to set maxdur = 0.

Further, did you try running GGIR with default parameters and did you inspect the pdf file in the result/QC folder? Often this gives a good idea of whether there is data to be processed.

That said, I just prepare a draft update to GGIR that avoid the error. Could you please try it out:

library(remotes)
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "issues_1179_1180")

Thanks,
Vincent
